title: The Shepherd and the Nightingale

full_text: A shepherd caged a nightingale to hear her sing. The bird sat silent. The shepherd realized that freedom is the very breath of song, and set her free, enjoying her melody from the forest boughs.
moral: True melody cannot be caged; art thrives only in liberty.
